nom: Lancôme Absolue Longevity MD Reset Face Cream for Mature Skin

segments.mature: Reviewers across their late 50s to 60s overwhelmingly report visibly softer fine lines, firmer skin and a more lifted, youthful look, often within two to six weeks; the one clear dissent is a post-menopausal reviewer with dry skin who saw no real difference and still felt tight.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who call it their holy grail, mostly report deep, lasting hydration and plumper skin; a couple disagree, saying it did not fully resolve their dryness or that the hydration fades by the following morning.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with rosacea who says other products often leave her skin redder, consistently report no irritation or breakouts, even with the cream's fragrance.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or normal-to-oily skin report the cream absorbs fully without feeling greasy or sitting on top of their skin, and does not cause breakouts.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin says the cream balanced her skin out and left it soft and even.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers, mostly in their late 50s to 60s, report visibly softer fine lines, firmer skin and a more lifted look within two to six weeks; a few disagree, saying they saw no real difference in firmness or lines even after weeks of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or aging skin, report deep, lasting hydration and plumper, less tight-feeling skin; a few disagree, saying the hydration does not last until morning, that it did not fully resolve their dryness, or that it works better as a lighter-season cream than a true winter moisturizer.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, even those normally cautious about rich creams, report no new breakouts or reactions; the one dissenting reviewer, with dry post-menopausal skin, woke up with small pimples after use.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who specifically checked for redness, including one with rosacea who says other products often make her skin look redder, report no increase in redness from this cream.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the cream with repairing her skin barrier alongside hydration, though no other reviewer discusses barrier effects specifically.
concerns.spots: The few reviewers who mention age spots are mixed: one reports a visible difference in her age spots alongside her wrinkles, while another says she still has both spots and wrinkles despite otherwise liking the cream.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or normal-to-oily skin say the cream absorbs fully without feeling greasy or sitting on top of the skin and does not trigger breakouts under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that still absorbs well
Fragrance too strong for a few, wish unscented
Heavy, bulky jar, not ideal for travel
A little product goes a long way

extraits.titre: Rich Creamy Old School Moisturizing Cream
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to love this cream but sadly it didn't work for me. I have dry post menopausal skin & I would wake up with small pimples. I loved the rich emollient old school texture but the smell was a little to grandma for me. I wanted to use this for a couple weeks to see if I saw a difference & I did not. My skin was somewhat hydrated but still felt tight unlike my regular cream I use. This has a lot going for it but sadly it didn't do the magic trick I needed for my skin. I use Erno Lazlo active phyetil cream & that stuffs magic. Lancome was generous enough to give me a sample of this cream for my review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Huge fan of Lancome for a while, but i think this one is okay for me. For the price point, I get it; it's not the top of line, but it still costs a pretty penny. The initial feel of this is that it's nice and makes my face feel soft and hydrated. However, it doesn't last long. I think by morning my face is really dry again. It will be a good summer cream, but not for winter or spring. One thing is that it's not greasy, smells nice, and absorbs quickly.

extraits.titre: Didn't provide enough moisture for my aging skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have aging skin that used to be oily and now is dry. This lovely cream absorbs nicely but doesn't provide the moisture I need. The jar is attractive and seems to hold a replaceable little tub of product. Not sure if they package it as a refillable but in any case that may help to keep costs down and then you aren't collecting little jars.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Product is super creamy and feels thick when you put it on. However it does dry quickly so you can apply your make up. I had no skin reaction at all to this product as I have rosacea and some products can make my skin redder looking. Jar is heavy and looks nicer but bigger than what I would like especially for travel

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been looking for a cream for my 66 year old skin and this is DEFINITELY what I wanted! It's not a heavy cream. Pretty much odorless for the most part. My skin feels and looks like my 35 year old self! Love it! Run now and get some! It's not gonna last!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review of it. I've always enjoyed Lancôme's creams and this one isn't any different. The packaging is extremely high quality and the cream is so smooth and moisturizing without being too thin or thick. I have oily skin and didn't experience any issues such as breakouts from this product or it just sitting on top of my skin rather than being absorbed.

extraits.titre: Found my Holy Grail skin cream
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Finally found the perfect treatment cream for my dry and sensitive skin! I noticed a difference around week 2. The fragrance is fresh but subtle. I provided long lasting hydration and helped with dullness. The texture is rich but not heavy. It melts into my skin. A little goes a long way so this product is a solid investment to add great results to your skin care. I highy reccomend it!
